in_greek.name: Εὐστάθιος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Eustazio is derived from the Greek word εύσταθεια (eustathia), which means 'well-flowing, prosperous, or stable'. In Greek mythology, the name Eustathios was borne by several figures, including a centaur and a king.

in_latin.name: Eustatius
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Eustatius is derived from the Greek name Εὐστάθιος (Eustathios). It means 'prosperous, well-flowing'. The name was borne by several saints in the early Christian church.
